caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic barrel or cask with a rounded cylindrical shape and light beige or off-white color, featuring prominent horizontal blue bands near the top, middle, and bottom. In the upper section of the barrel, there is a semicircular blue inscription reading "H.C.N." with a central hop or floral motif positioned below it and the words "Meyle & Co. Albany" written in smaller blue letters underneath. In the central part of the barrel, there is a detailed blue illustration of a fish depicted in profile, appearing elongated and textured. The barrel stands upright with a flat, round wooden lid on top, showing some brown coloring, and a spout or tap opening near the base with a small protruding rectangular piece. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Holland Gin Keg
